changes.before: The Empress Dowager has died in indignation.
changes.after: To this day the Empress Dowager, having given way to indignation, suddenly passed away.
changes.reason: The English omits 至今 and 一旦 from 至今太后發憤，一旦升遐, collapsing a causal 'to this day / suddenly' death notice into a bare perfect.
